mission.title: kyverno: [Bug] Policy namespaceSelector is applied to Webhooks
mission.description: [Bug] Policy namespaceSelector is applied to Webhooks. This issue affects 11+ users.

steps.title: Identify kyverno troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your kyverno deployment:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n kyverno -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kyverno
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kyverno -n kyverno --tail=100 | grep -i error
```
Look for errors or warnings in the logs that may indicate the issue.

steps.title: Review kyverno configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant kyverno configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n kyverno -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kyverno
kubectl get configmap -n kyverno -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=kyverno
```
When creating a mutating policy, the spec.matchConstraints.namespaceSelector are used to also set the webhooks.namespaceSelector of the MutatingWebhookConfiguration (kyverno-resource-mutating-webhook-cfg) object, effectivelly limiting the webhook to

steps.title: Apply the fix for [Bug] Policy namespaceSelector is applied to Webhooks
steps.description:
we are expreiencing same issue but for us its intermittent and its due to `objectSelector`

Kyverno Version: v1.18.0
Kubernetes Version: v1.33.0

For us its merging 2 policies and overriding `objectSelector` which is only used in one of the policy
1.

steps.title: Confirm [Bug] Policy namespaceSelector is applied to… is resolved
steps.description:
Verify the fix by checking that the original error no longer occurs:
```bash
kubectl logs -l app.kubernetes.io/name=kyverno -n kyverno --tail=50 --since=5m
kubectl get events -n kyverno --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm that the issue symptoms are gone.
